summary: preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes heavily obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and then invokes it on the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB heavily obfuscated bundle (hex-identifier variables, a 900+ entry string-array with a push/shift rotation decoder, and index-lookup literal encoding) — no readable plaintext logic. The package presents itself as a ServiceTitan React MFE UI module (`@servicetitan/mfe-quick-actions`); fetching an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time solely to execute an opaque bundled script is unrelated to that stated purpose and specifically bypasses Node-based install-time scanners. The alternate-runtime-plus-obfuscated-loader shape at preinstall time causes attacker-controlled code to run on the installer's machine on `npm install` without further consent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
